route_task: SlotSPE / SPE-08 / truth audit of near-zero gating and 29-patient claim

source_facts: parallel_topk_st selects logits plus Gumbel noise; the soft weighting uses unnoised scores at temperature 0.01.
MoESlotDecoder.forward masks the global softmax, then divides by selected mass plus 1e-8. Gate weights sum to S/(S+1e-8), not necessarily 1.
If S is much smaller than 1e-8, the normalized weight sum is near zero; low temperature and excluding the unnoised maximum allow this.
The weighted decoder logits enter unimodal auxiliary survival losses during training.
SlotSPE.forward discards the soft gate output and passes hard_keep.bool() to the self-attention/reconstruction branches; final fused logits are computed separately.
For a frozen original model and identical selected masks/slots, changing only normalized soft weights leaves final fused logits unchanged by dataflow. This does not imply no training-time harm.
Replacing stochastic selection with deterministic top-2 also changes the masks; its C-index difference cannot isolate soft-normalization harm.
